definitions.explanation: Plates, bowls, cups, and other items used for serving and eating food.

examples.japanese: {食器|しょっき}を{洗|あら}ってください。
{新|あたら}しい{食器|しょっき}セットを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a new dinnerware set.

examples.japanese: {食器|しょっき}{棚|だな}に{皿|さら}を{片|かた}づけた。
examples.english: I put away the plates in the cupboard.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{食器|しょっき}を{洗|あら}う (to wash dishes)
・{食器|しょっき}{棚|だな} (cupboard for dishes)
・{食器|しょっき}{洗|あら}い{機|き} (dishwasher)
・{食器|しょっき}セット (dinnerware set)
・{食器|しょっき}{乾燥機|かんそうき} (dish dryer)

INCLUDES:
・{皿|さら} (plates)
・{茶碗|ちゃわん} (rice bowls)
・{椀|わん} (soup bowls)
・コップ/グラス (cups/glasses)
・{箸|はし} (chopsticks) - sometimes included

[Register: Neutral]
